title: Writing --- Your Own Line
label: ch:escribir-frase-propia
canDo: I can write a greeting and my name from a closed supply of known words, choosing the greeting the hour asks for.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-W01-frase-propia: with no model to copy, choose one of four greetings by the hour and order it in front of me llamo.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. Every earlier step supplied a model; this chapter introduces the one atom that names the difference, and the payoff assesses it directly.
